responsibility: Defines the tree_stmt_iterator abstraction and associated helpers for traversing and editing GENERIC statement lists. It provides iterator operations, a range wrapper for C++ iteration, update-mode enums for insertion semantics, and declarations for list allocation, insertion, deletion, and expression-selection helpers used by generic tree and gimplification code.
same_name_distinction: Defines the tree_stmt_iterator abstraction, inline traversal helpers, range wrapper, and insertion-mode enum for statement lists. Unlike gcc/tree-iterator.cc, it specifies the iterator interface and lightweight inline operations rather than implementing list mutation/storage routines.
